terms.comment: Our descriptive expression for the broader work of quality assurance. cūrātiō, cūrātiōnis f. — care, oversight or management; quālitās, quālitātis f. — quality, property or character. Classical quālitās does not by itself mean “high quality.” Testing is one part of QA, so this and probātiō quālitātis, quality testing, are not exact synonyms. Both expressions recover proposals from our 21 September 2026 conversation. The dictionary sources establish the component words and their older senses; they do not establish these complete phrases as standardized software terminology.

sources: Lewis & Short: curatio · Lewis & Short: qualitas. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
